mn_bca_a1.publisher: MnDOT Office of Transportation System Management

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: p. 1, 'Per-crash comprehensive costs' (Most Likely column); note 7, p. 2
rules: per crash by its most severe injury, one cost per level for every location type (Most Likely column; Low/High are a sensitivity range)
the table gives these as SFY 2026 standard values and names no dollar year for crash costs (its CO2 line is 2024$)
U (injury, level not reported) is left unpriced (shared rule) and counted

statewide_rates.missing: MnDOT's crash-rate page (dot.state.mn.us/trafficeng/safety/crash_complex.html, read 2026-11-08) gives only the formulas; its BCA guidance says facility-type averages come from MnDOT District Traffic Engineering offices. No published table found, and CrashIQ has no Minnesota traffic counts

screening.state_method: MnDOT critical crash rate and severity rate against district facility-type averages (not read into CrashIQ)

min_years.missing: not found in the MnDOT documents read on 2026-11-08 (Table A.1, the BCA guidance page, the crash-rate page)
